units: inverter readings (one inverter SCADA interval reading each); string checks (one string current value checked against its expected band); peak inverter heatsink temperature in deg C

grains.RAW.PLANTS: one row per fictional solar plant (ground-mount fixed tilt, single-axis tracker, floating solar, rooftop C&I, solar-plus-storage) in one of 6 Vietnam cities
grains.RAW.PLANT_DAILY: one row per plant per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.EQUIPMENT_READINESS: one row per plant (spare string inverter, tracker drive motor, pontoon float kit, inverter cooling fan or battery module snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.loss_event_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(generation loss event in next 7 days) per plant, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day fleet-wide inverter-reading volume FORECAST; peak inverter temperature ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.PLANT_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic generation loss response SOPs (one per plant type and cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.SOLAR_PERFORMANCE_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.SOLAR_PERFORMANCE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, generation loss event, cause and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (KPIs, daily in-range inverter readings, generation loss events by plant, event risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
